Jessica — thanks, yes to all of the items you listed. High-level answers below; Marissa will follow with the technical sample CSV/JSON and schema.

- Logged fields: authenticated principal (user/service account), action type (create/generate/export/ingest), resource id (model endpoint, job id), request metadata (IP, region, token counts, request id).
- Export formats: we support CSV exports and newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON). We can provide sample exports in both formats.
- Retention: retention windows are configurable at the customer level. Standard hosted retention is 90 days by default; we support custom retention policies up to 7 years for enterprise/private deployments. Archived logs for legal hold can be exported as CSV/NDJSON on request; export can be run by customer admins or by Redwood under a support request/PO if needed.
- SOC2: attached is the redacted SOC2 summary for our hosted environment (redwood_soc2_summary_redacted.pdf). We can provide the full report under NDA.

Marissa — can you drop the sample export and an export_schema.md into Drive and paste links here? Also please include a very small sample CSV (anonymized) we can hand to FinCo's compliance team.

Aditya

Subject: Audit log export sample & schema (FinCo)

Hi Jessica / FinCo security —

Per the thread, attaching a very small anonymized sample and the export schema. I've also uploaded the files to a shared Drive folder for easy access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Quick notes on the sample and capabilities:

- Sample export file: audit_logs_sample.csv (3 rows, anonymized) includes columns:
  timestamp, principal_type, principal_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, ip, region, token_count, bytes_out

- NDJSON export: identical schema but each line is a JSON object (suitable for log ingestion).

- Retention & legal hold:
  - Configurable retention policy per-customer (90d default).
  - For enterprise customers we support retention up to 7 years and an "export to archive" flow that exports historical logs to customer S3 or a secure Share.
  - Legal hold: we can generate an export (CSV/NDJSON) for the requested date ranges and deliver via secure transfer (pre-signed S3 link or SFTP) within the SLA window agreed in contract.

- Access controls:
  - Audit logs are immutable and include principal identifiers; access to view/export logs is scoped to customer admin roles.
  - For hosted customers, full admin exports require an approved support request. For Dedicated/Private deployments, exports can be run by customer admins directly.

Attached for initial review: audit_logs_sample.csv, export_schema.md

Let me know if you need a different CSV delimiter or a particular timezone formatting. Happy to jump on the call Mon 10am PT to walk through.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
